definition: Class of the run's ENA organism/scientific_name label: not_flagged (metagenome/community term), named_human_host ('Homo sapiens' — routine submitter label, NOT a quality signal), named_nonhuman_host (a non-human animal species, e.g. Mus musculus), named_microbe_or_other (a single named microbe or other non-community organism). Sample-level column = highest-priority class over the sample's runs (nonhuman_host > microbe_or_other > human_host > not_flagged).

Sandpiper rule: organism name names a single specific species (including 'Homo sapiens'); names containing 'metagenome' or community terms (uncultured, environmental sample, enrichment/mixed culture, microbial community, consortium, microbiome) and placeholders (bacterium, unidentified, archaeon, prokaryote, eukaryote, organism, microorganism) are not flagged. Kept for reproducibility; noisy because of the human-host label.
Sandpiper rule: organism name lacks 'metagenome' and any community term; placeholders still count as flagged.
True when sp_nonmeta_class in {named_nonhuman_host, named_microbe_or_other} over the sample's runs (v1.2.1; v1.2.0 used the strict rule and was dominated by the 'Homo sapiens' label).
Organism name contains 'synthetic' or 'simulat', or library_source = SYNTHETIC. Sample level: any run.
library_strategy in {RNA-Seq, miRNA-Seq, FL-cDNA, ssRNA-seq, ncRNA-Seq, RIP-Seq, Ribo-seq, EST} or library_source in {METATRANSCRIPTOMIC, TRANSCRIPTOMIC, TRANSCRIPTOMIC SINGLE CELL}.
As strict, plus library_source in {OTHER, SYNTHETIC}.
Any run fires the strict RNA rule.
Sandpiper low-complexity rule on the profile (few taxa dominate). Expected for Bifidobacterium-/Enterobacterales-dominated neonatal stool; display only, never a triage input.
Root coverage < 2 genome equivalents (sample level: summed over profiled runs). Such samples are excluded from study panels and study medians (v1.2.1).
Sandpiper reports a warning on the prokaryotic read fraction (sp_spf) for the run.
Sandpiper's sp_prediction / sp_host_or_not says the community looks environmental rather than host-associated.

site_label: Low known-species fraction at high depth
definition: Known-species fraction low despite adequate depth — novel community or off-target sample; study-level fraction is frac_low_ksf_high_depth_profiled.
Fraction of the study's runs with sp_nonmeta_class in {named_nonhuman_host, named_microbe_or_other} or synthetic or RNA (strict). The 'Homo sapiens' label is not counted.
Fraction of profiled samples with sp_flag_low_complexity.
Fraction of profiled samples with sp_low_depth.
Hint that a study deserves a human look (reason in sp_auditor_reason); never a verdict.
Every classification in the condensed GTDB profile stops at domain. Not shipped in this package (all catalog profiles reach phylum or deeper for the run set used).
GlobDB-scheme profile flag. UNUSED: the catalog uses GTDB profiles only.
UNUSED: requires the GlobDB profile, which the catalog does not use.
